stories.headline: Crew Gathers For Friday Movie Night
stories.article: Lauren hosted a movie night for the whole crew on Friday.

stories.headline: Lauren's First Loaf Rises To Occasion
stories.article: Lauren tried baking bread for the first time. It actually rose.

panels.scene: Lauren in living room arranging cushions near TV, excited expression, medium eye-level shot, soft lamp light
panels.caption: Friday prep in full swing.

panels.scene: Lauren sitting on couch watching TV with group of friends, happy relaxed expression, front view from TV side
panels.caption: The crew settles in for the show.

panels.scene: Lauren in kitchen kneading dough on counter, focused expression, side close-up angle, flour on counter
dialogue: First time baking bread, let's see.
panels.caption: A brand new baking adventure begins.

panels.scene: Lauren in kitchen opening oven and looking at risen bread loaf, delighted surprised expression, eye-level shot
panels.caption: Success is rising nicely.
